Selling was broad-based across automobile assemblers, cement, commercial banks, fertiliser, oil & gas exploration and OMCs — the same sectors that led Thursday's rally. Against the Jan 23, 2026 all-time high of 189,556, the drawdown is back to roughly 4.35% — still well clear of the 10% line that would trigger deploying the AICF/MICF cash reserve; no change to the dry-powder plan. SBP's policy rate remains at 11.5% (held Jul 27); headline inflation eased to 11.1% in June; no new IMF program developments this week — stable macro backdrop otherwise. Fund NAVs (ASSF, AKDISSF, NISIF, NISF, MIF, AICF, MICF) are unchanged from yesterday since MUFAP publishes once daily near 21:30 PKT, after this review's snapshot. On holdings: EFERT's Rs 1.75/share interim dividend ex-date (Aug 10, 2026, payment Sep 3) is now confirmed 3 days out — no news since the confirmed H1 results (profit -15.9% YoY consolidated, -34.6% YoY standalone). Either the trade happened off-app and index.html needs updating, or it's still pending — Sep 2, 2026 earnings (under four weeks away) remains the hard exit deadline. The board still declared an interim dividend of Rs 1.75/share (17.5%) on top of the Rs 2.00/share (20%) already paid this year — yield is intact for now. Keep for yield given the dividend held up, but this is now the second straight half with declining core earnings — rotate out if Q3/Q4 offtake doesn't recover or the next dividend gets cut outright.
